policies.ambiguous_symbols: Preserved and counted; no consensus base is imputed
policies.duplicate_accessions: Compare exact versioned accession strings; identical copies retain the first record; conflicting sequences for one accession.version are quarantined; different versions remain distinct
policies.gaps: Gap-containing records are quarantined for review; no alignment gaps are removed
policies.identical_sequences: SHA-256 candidate grouping followed by exact sequence equality; different accessions remain retained; reverse complements are not merged
policies.metadata_join: Join by exact accession.version, not by CSV/FASTA row position
policies.nucleotide_alphabet: ACGT plus IUPAC ambiguity symbols RYSWKMBDHVN
policies.partial_sequences: Retain valid COMPLETE, PARTIAL and UNKNOWN records; no minimum-length threshold is applied
policies.raw_inputs: Task 1 files are read-only and never modified
policies.sequence_alignment: Not performed; alignment belongs to Task 3
policies.taxonomic_scope: tax_id 10407 or an NCBI lineage containing the exact Hepatitis B virus taxon; known non-HBV Hepadnaviridae are excluded; incomplete/contradictory taxonomy is reviewed
policies.unsupported_symbols: Reject records containing symbols outside the DNA IUPAC alphabet, U and gap
policies.uracil: U-containing records are quarantined for manual review; no U-to-T conversion is performed

warnings: Records with missing metadata length are retained with the original field left blank; actual sequence length is recorded separately.
A valid IUPAC ambiguity symbol is retained but may be unsuitable for a definitive mutation call at that position.
